updated_research_gap_analysis.updated_assessment: Campaign 0007 explained transition and USD contamination, but it did not add a governed positioning proxy to separate healthy continuation from overcrowded bull exhaustion.
USD spillover intensity now explains part of the failure, but richer real-yield decomposition remains outside the frozen dataset stack.
Persistent-versus-transition replay confirmed that overlap windows are the main contamination source, but the regime stack still cannot isolate crisis-overlap episodes more finely.
Branch and range diagnostics improved understanding, but the experiment program still cannot determine whether gold led or followed the broader repricing wave.
The governed stack still pools heterogeneous macro-transition events together, limiting how precisely H0405 can be explained across event types.
Wide-range contamination is now documented clearly, but no richer governed liquidity-quality proxy exists beyond the frozen range and event-pressure measures.
Campaign 0007 expanded the governed handoff universe from 7 to 18 episodes, reducing uncertainty, but coverage remains too thin for institutional re-validation.
Daily sequence replay improved path accounting, but the absence of governed intraday ordering data still blocks decisive causal interpretation.
The diagnostic program still lacks a governed proxy showing when slower trend-following capital truly adopts the handoff after the macro shock.
